description: Your media server: libraries, playing now
agentGuide: Libraries: GET /library/sections (key, title, type); its items: GET /library/sections/<key>/all (add ?type=1 films, 2 shows; ?sort=addedAt:desc; ?title=<words>). Recently added: GET /library/recentlyAdded; on deck: GET /library/onDeck; search: GET /search?query=<words>; one item: GET /library/metadata/<ratingKey> (children: /library/metadata/<ratingKey>/children). What is playing: GET /status/sessions; history: GET /status/sessions/history/all. Refresh a library: GET /library/sections/<key>/refresh. Answers come as MediaContainer.Metadata[]. The token is set by Allkin.
